title: The Transmission — EN/ES/FR (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 98bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic clear signal triumphant Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The transmission came through clean at seventeen past three
A signal so precise it cut the static perfectly
The message was as clear as anything has ever been
The transmission was the clearest thing that I have ever seen

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La transmisión llegó clara a las tres y diecisiete
[The transmission came through clean at seventeen past three]
Una señal tan precisa que cortó la estática — lo que se puede
[A signal so precise it cut the static — what can be done]
El mensaje fue tan claro como cualquier cosa ha sido
[The message was as clear as anything has ever been]
La transmisión fue lo más claro que he recibido
[The transmission was the clearest thing I have received]

[Chorus — English]
The transmission carries everything across the empty space
Between the mind that sent it and the mind that found the place
The transmission is complete — the data made it through
The transmission is the bridge between what I know and you
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La transmission est arrivée proprement à trois heures dix-sept
[The transmission came through clean at three seventeen]
Un signal si précis qu'il a coupé la statique — tel est cet acte
[A signal so precise it cut the static — such is this act]
Le message était aussi clair que n'importe quoi de jamais été
[The message was as clear as anything has ever been]
La transmission était la chose la plus claire que j'ai trouvée
[The transmission was the clearest thing I have found]

[Outro — All three languages]
The transmission came through… La transmisión llegó… La transmission est arrivée
Clear and complete — Clara y completa — Claire et complète
That's my boy
